mission: Use Buddy to help open-source and openly released/open-weight AI advance through reproducible evaluation, original implementations, tooling, datasets, documentation, and community contributions.
comparison_rules: Compare models using matched task distributions and documented protocols.
Separate model capability from hardware, prompt, retrieval, and tool advantages.
Record model version, evaluator version, dataset version, and configuration.
Do not imply a model is open source when its license only permits open weights or another narrower form of access.
Do not copy proprietary model weights, restricted data, or protected source code.
Prefer independently implemented improvements and clearly attributed upstream work.

open_progress_index.score_rule: Every score must reference reproducible evidence and must identify the evaluated model and version.

north_star: Buddy should not merely consume open models; it should help researchers and developers measure weaknesses, build original improvements, and return useful knowledge, tools, tests, and code to the open ecosystem.
